h: A Full Day Out for the Family
p: Southampton makes a great base for a family day that mixes thrills with fresh air. Karting suits older children and teenagers best, but junior drivers need to meet minimum age and height rules, so check those before you book.

If you've got younger kids who aren't quite tall enough to race, there's plenty to keep them happy nearby. Paultons Park, home of Peppa Pig World, is a short drive away on the edge of the New Forest, and it's a firm favourite with little ones. The New Forest itself, with its free-roaming ponies, is perfect for a picnic and a gentle walk.

Back in the city, Southampton Common is a huge green space for a runaround, and the Solent Sky museum is packed with aircraft, including a giant flying boat you can climb aboard. It's also home to an example of the Spitfire, which was designed in Southampton by R. J. Mitchell.
On the track, encourage the kids to look ahead and be smooth. Braking before the corner and accelerating gently on the way out makes a huge difference to lap times.
Southampton Central station has good links to London and along the south coast.
Book ahead in school holidays, bring water and plan food for afterwards. Flat, closed shoes and comfy clothes are a must for everyone in the kart.
